title: Number-Shape Pegs
short: Each digit gets a peg that looks like its shape: 2 is a swan, 8 is a snowman, 5 is a hook.
trouble: Picking a shape that you have to work to see. The shape should jump out.

blocks.html: Some people find it easier to see a number than to hear a rhyme. Number-shape pegs use what each digit looks like. Here is one common set; pick your own if another shape is clearer to you.

head: Digit
Peg
Why
rows: a curve hanging from a bar
a curved head at the bottom

blocks.html: Look at the digit, see its object, then link the item to that object.

blocks.title: Worked example
blocks.q: Use shape pegs: item 8 is a trumpet.
steps: Link: a snowman playing a trumpet so loudly his carrot nose falls off.
